paite: Joshua ahong upata a, ahong tek mahmahta hi. TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Na hong upa in na hong tek mahmahta a, gam lak ding lah atam lai mahmah ngal a.
heading: Gam Lak Lai Ding

paite: Hiai gamte ahi lak louh: Philistia gam tengteng leh Geshur gam tengteng.

Aigupta gam chin a om Shihor a pan mallam pang a Ekron gamgi tan in, huai tuh Kanaan mite gam a sim ahi; Philistiate vaihawmtu ngate, Gaza mite, Ashdod mite, Ashkelon mite Git mite leh Ekron mite: simlam a Avi mite.
Kanaan mite gam tengteng leh Zidon mite gam a Mearah, Amorte gamgi Aphek kho pha in.
Gebal mite gam leh nisuahna lam Lebanon gam tengteng Hermon tang nuai Baal-gad a pan Hamath kholutna pha in.
Lebanon a pan Misrephoth-maim mun pha in, tanggam a teng tengteng, Zidon mi tengteng. Amaute Israel suante ma ah ka delhkhe dia; ka hon thupiak bang in Israel gouluah ding in bawlsak in.
Huchi in hiai gam nam kuate leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte gouluah ding in hawmsak in," achi hi.
TOUPA sikha Mosi in amau a dia asehsak bang in Reuben suante leh Gad suante'n Manasseh nam kimkhat dangte toh Mosi piaksa Jordan suahlam gam ah goutan aneita uhi.
heading: Jordan Suahlam Gam Hawmna

paite: Huai gam ahihleh Arnon Phaizang gei a om Aroer a pan leh phaizang laitak a khopi leh Medeba phaigam tengteng, Dibon tan ahi.
Amorte kumpipa Sihon, Heshbon a vaihawm a tu khopi tengteng Ammon suante gamgi tan ahi.
Gilead gam leh Geshurte leh Maakathte gamgi chiang leh Hermon tang tengteng leh Bashan gam tengteng Salkah kho tan ahi.
Astaroth leh Edrei a kumpipa a tu Bashan gam kumpipa Og gam tengteng toh, huaite Rephaim nam milian khosuaksunte ahi uh; huaite Mosi in ana dou a, ana delhkheta hi.
Himahleh Geshurte leh Maakathte Israel suante'n adelhkhe kei ua; Geshurte leh Maakathte tuni tan in Israelte lak ah atengden lai uhi.
Levi namte kia ahi gouluah ding a piak louh. Akiang ua ana gensa bang in TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian a dia mei a thillatte amau gouluah ahi.
Reuben suante nam a-inkuan dungzui in Mosi in gam ana peta hi.
heading: Reuben Gam Tan

paite: Agamgi uh Arnon Phaizang a om Aroer a pan phaizang laitak a khopi leh Medeba phaigam tengteng a pan,
Heshbon leh huai phaigam a khopi tengteng; Debon, Bamoth-baal leh Beth-baal-meon;
Jahaz, Kedemoth leh Mephaath;
Kiriathaim, Sibmah leh phaizang a tang a om Zereth-sahar;
Beth-peor leh Ashdot-pisgah leh Beth-jeshimoth;
Phaigam khopi tengteng, Heshbon a vaihawm Amorte Kumpipa Sihon lalgam teng, Mosi in ana thah khitsa Midiante kumpipate Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur leh Reba omna gam toh ahi.
Beor tapa Balaam, aisan siam leng a-inkuante toh Israel suante'n athat uhi.
Reuben suante gam chiang bel Jordan leh apang teng ahi. Hiai gam leh akhopite leh khuate ahi Reuben suante a dia a-inkuan omdan bang zel a gouluah dia asehsak uh.
Mosi in Gad suante a-inkuan dungzui un gam apia hi.
heading: Gad Gam Tan

paite: Agamgi uh Jazer khua leh Gilead gam khopi tengteng leh Ammon suante gam kimkhat, Rabbah kho kiang a om Aroer pha in;
Heshbon a pan Ramath-mizpeh leh Betonim pha in; Mahanaim a pan Debir gamgi pha in;
Guam ah Beth-aram, Beth-nimrah, Sukoth, Zaphon, Heshbon kumpipa Sihon gam teng, Jordan leh agei a gamte, Jordan gal suahlam pang a Kinereth Tuipi tawp chiang tan in ahi.
Hiai Gad suante a dia a-inkuan omdan bang zel a agouluah ding ua seh, akhopite uh leh akhuate uh ahi.
Mosi in Manasseh nam kimkhatte gam apia hi. Manasseh nam kimkhatte a dia a-inkuan omdan bang zel a piak ahi uh.
heading: Suahlam A Manasseh Gam Tan

paite: Agamgi uh Mahanaim a pan Bashan gam tengteng. Bashan gam kumpipa Og gam tengteng leh Bashan gam a Jair khopi tengteng toh, kho sawmguk ahi.
Gilead gam kimkhat leh Bashan gam kumpipa Og gam a Astaroth, Edrei; huai Manasseh tapa Makir suan Makir suan kimkhatte a dia a-inkuan uh omdan bang zel a seh ahi.
Hiaite Moab phai, Jeriko zawn, Jordan gal lehlam a, Mosi in gouluah dia a piak gamte ahi uh.
Levi chite Mosi in gouluah ding ape kei hi. Akiang ua ana gensa bang in TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian agouluah uh ahi.
